question: How many players are there on a standard Kho Kho team during a match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Each team consists of 12 players, but during a contest, only 9 players from each side take the field.**
 
• In a match, there are two innings. In an innings, each team gets seven minutes for chasing and seven minutes for defending.
 
• **Kho Kho was started in the state of Maharashtra.**
 
• The **game has been popular in Marathi-speaking people.**
 
• The Asian Kho Kho Federation first came into existence in 1987 at the time of the third South Asian Federation Games held in Calcutta.
 
• The** game gained international credit with the First Asian Kho Kho championship was held in Kolkata in 1996.**
